description: Adaptive Surface 0.12.6: generated world pack becomes an internal startup cache, eliminating the persisted mandatory-mod dependency for new JAR-only installations.
changes: Store the generated pack under mods/Zytale_AdaptiveSurface/generated; register it during setup before the initial LoadAssetEvent, without runtime asset reload.
Persist a disabled legacy pack entry; synchronously save an old enabled entry before moving its ZIP so a crash cannot leave a missing mandatory pack.
Move old pack bytes intact and preserve the existing fail-closed rebuild/fallback mechanism. Retain both legacy and internal inventories in next-start builds.
Update the backup/rollback installer for worlds already blocked by client preflight. Target the installed 0.7.4 server and keep all asset bytes unchanged.
advantages: Fresh single-JAR installation and deleted-cache restart no longer require a separately downloaded generated mod
Old working material bytes survive missing-index migration
disadvantages: A Java plugin cannot repair an old world before client preflight; already blocked saves require one-time local metadata migration
No actual client join or hosted-browser download was automated; no publication
Adaptive Window cold-cache material learning may reject a first placement until restart; no Window package changed
Public asset licensing limits from 0.12.5 remain open
test_results: 279130 core assertions pass. Nine final native runs pass on installed Hytale 0.7.4 (three ordinary-JAR asset-validation boots and six separate integration boots).
Client prerequisite model detects the exact missing identifier in the affected original save and none after the repair. It is explicitly a model, not a client-UI test.
Copied affected world: 9173 saved chunks scanned, 67 startup materials/2211 states validated; original offline repair includes its 65 required materials.
Missing-index legacy migration and reopen preserve the 89-material pack byte-for-byte; window placement/reopen checks pass for 21 variants after their material cache is prepared.
1753 asset files byte-identical to 0.12.5; no integration/test classes or synthetic catalogue entries in ordinary JAR.
Installed locally with backups; all 58 universe files and other four mod JARs unchanged. Only original config change is the generated Surface pack Enabled=false.

source_refs.description: Observed missing-mod failure, local repair and startup validation on installed Hytale 0.7.4
Final artifact hashes, nine native passes, preliminary failure retained, preservation audit
